_comment: Where every input of the project lives. playground.ipynb reads this file; nothing here is secret.

bdd100k.name: BDD100K
bdd100k.version: BDD100K 100K images, 2020 label release (validation split; lane + det_20 labels)
bdd100k.license: BDD100K License (UC Berkeley): educational, research and not-for-profit use; copies must keep the copyright notice; commercial use needs a separate license.

mirror._comment: Used only when the official server is unreachable. Same BDD100K 100K release (all splits, lane labels, scene tags) in Supervisely format.

culane.name: CULane
culane.version: CULane (Pan et al., AAAI 2018), test split: 34,680 frames in 9 scene categories

file_ids._comment: Optional. Paste a Google Drive file ID here if the automatic folder listing fails (right-click the file in the official Drive folder > Share > Copy link; the ID is the long code in the link).

culane.license: CULane terms (SenseTime): non-commercial research and teaching only; cite the dataset; do not redistribute the images or modified versions.

mutcd.name: MUTCD 11th Edition, Part 3 (Markings)
mutcd.license: U.S. federal government work (FHWA); no copyright restrictions.

gb5768.name: GB 5768.3-2025 Road traffic signs and markings, Part 3: Road traffic markings
gb5768.license: Mandatory national standard, free to read on the official platform; the text is copyrighted, so only short quoted passages go into the repository.
